name: Stream shorts
author: openopusclip
description: Vertical shorts cut from a screen-share stream: one complete thing each — a question with its whole answer, or one idea explained — opening on the message from the chat it answers, the screen above and the camera below, and your own end card at the end.

quickActions.label: Cut shorts from this stream
quickActions.text: Find the complete moments in {selection} — a question from the chat with its whole answer, or one idea explained on its own — and cut them with the Stream shorts — clip template.

quickActions.label: Open on the chat
quickActions.text: For {selection}, find the message from the chat it answers and open the clip on it, with the hook coming in after.

quickActions.label: Start where the thought starts
quickActions.text: Check the edges of {selection}: move the start to where the thought actually begins and the end to just after it lands. Nothing mid-sentence at either end.
